name: Only God Can Judge
overview: Scripture teaches that judgment belongs ultimately to God alone, warning believers not to judge others harshly or superficially. Jesus instructs us not to judge so that we will not be judged, emphasizing mercy and forgiveness as foundational attitudes (Matthew 7:1, Luke 6:37). While righteous judgment is encouraged, it must be discerning and not based on outward appearances (John 7:24). James reminds us that God is the sole lawgiver with authority to save or destroy, challenging us to refrain from passing final judgment on others (James 4:12).
